newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Jan 21.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik is preparing a new business code which should bring about an improved tax system with an emphasis on effective tax collection. The project will ensure that firms cannot begin new companies and leave the old debts with the previous entreprises.
- The futures of five banks which are going through compulsory administration by the Czech National Bank are still unknown. Of the five, only Agrobanka appears likely to obtain a strategic investor.
- According to experts, substantial growth in the amount of leasing this year is caused by the increase in resident's buying power and the increase in requests for more expensive consumer goods.

- Defence Minister Miloslav Vyborny stated yesterday that if the Czech Army does not go through radical changes soon, it will lead to its paralysis in three to four years and complete powerlessness of the country's defense system.

PRAVO - German Chancellor Helmut Kohl is flying to Prague today for a two day visit during which he and Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus will sign the Czech-German Declaration. German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel decided to postpone his trip to Asia so he could fly to Prague with Kohl.

LIDOVE NOVINY - Chairman of the Parliament, Milos Zeman, handed over his documents, which allegedly contain evidence of illegal activities by the secret service (BIS) and the Interior Ministry, to the parliamentary committee for controlling the BIS.

- According to the Czech Foreign Ministry, membership in NATO for the Czech Republic and other countries could be threatened by the attitude of Turkey, which conditions its support of expanding NATO on Turkey being accepted by the EC.

MLADA FRONTA DNES - The Czech-German Declaration, which is to be signed today by German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus, has still not gained the support of the opposition Social Democrats.

- Czech director Jan Sverak was awarded a Golden Globe for best foreign film for his film Kolja on Sunday. Another Czech director Milos Forman was given two Golden Globe awards for best director and best screenplay for his film People vs Larry Flint.
